annotations.title: My portfolio: every position and what can change for me

description: YOUR OWN VAULT PORTFOLIO, EVERY POSITION AND WHAT CAN CHANGE FOR YOU. Needs the API key of the account that entered the positions on /account/passport or watches the addresses: it answers that account only and never anyone else’s addresses. Per position: `overview` (vault, network, source by hand | address | overlap, the value counted in the total with its time, gain with its definition or unknown, the top change since entry, the highest finding, the exit against your own size, the alert state) and `watch`, the rows of what can change under you — exit (venue-reported liquidity ÷ your position, a stored simulation or "not tested", larger holders ahead), control (role changes since entry, pending caps or market removals, control not established), where the money goes (new collateral, collateral price against its reference, PT maturities within 30 days, borrowers’ health ≤ 1.10, bad debt), concentration (largest holder and top five against entry), outflows (labelled NOT your return), yield (delivered against quoted in ONE convention, as "97.0% of the quoted rate; −0.18 pp"; a zero or negative quote is not comparable; share-price drawdown), sanctions (an exact match in the screened scope, never a clearance) and data freshness. Each row: entry, now, status ok | watch | alert | unknown | delayed, source, asOf, and the alert kind its "Alert me" arms (`alertKinds.notYetEvaluated` lists kinds declared and not yet evaluated). Unknown is never ok; an input older than its allowed age is `delayed`. Venue-reported liquidity is shared by every holder and is not a withdrawal tested for you. `dedup` shows how each position is counted once (hand entries − overlap = hand contribution, plus address positions). Free with an account.
name: my_portfolio_positions

alertKinds.description: rows: the alert kind each row arms; notYetEvaluated: kinds declared with their rule and default threshold, not evaluated yet; arm: how to set one through PUT /v1/watches.

allowance.description: Positions by hand: used, freeLimit (3 by default), limit (the plan’s where a plan is live), hasPlan, canAdd, needsPlan, overFree (kept beyond the free ones), says, and upgrade (where to read what a plan includes).

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

counts.description: positions, vaults (unique), overlapping, and the sentence "3 positions, 2 unique vaults, 1 overlapping record".

dedup.description: manualEnteredUsd, overlapUsd, manualContributionUsd, addressUsd, combinedUsd and the lines of the step-by-step count.

gain.description: usd and pct (gain ÷ current net deposits, hand-entered positions only), its definition, and coverage: how much of the portfolio has a known cost basis. Unknown is not zero.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

method.description: How positions are counted and what each status means.

positions.description: Each position: key, positionId (hand entries), overview (with `rating`: the vault’s ASPERN rating letter, version, coverage and strongest component, the letter vault_rating gives; null where no document is stored), watch (rows with key, group, label, entry, now, status, says, source, asOf, alertKind, alertThreshold), armed (the alert kinds you set on its vault) and plan: included, or needs_plan for a hand position beyond the free ones on an account without a plan, kept and readable with its overview, its `watch` empty and `withheld` saying why.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: My portfolio: every position and what can change for me
